name: Hovi
description: A voice skin with Hovi, a little hovering robot (or robot cat) whose face is drawn live on its screen: glowing lens eyes that blink and look around, a mouth that moves with the answer, and lights that sweep, pulse and spin as it listens, thinks and talks. It can dress up for holidays, picked by hand or by a Home Assistant entity.
author: Ponderosa

settings.title: Holiday
settings.description: The outfit and light colours. Follow Home Assistant reads the holiday entity below; any state that isn't one of these holidays shows the everyday robot.

settings.title: Holiday entity
settings.description: The Home Assistant entity whose state names the holiday, used with Follow Home Assistant, such as an input_select you change yourself or a template sensor. Leave it empty for the everyday robot.

settings.title: Frame rate
settings.description: Auto starts at full speed and drops to 30, then 20 fps on a device that can't keep up, such as an Echo Show. Each kiosk decides for itself, so one synced setting suits a mixed fleet.

settings.title: Darkness
settings.description: How dark the robot's white shell is, in percent. Highlights stay bright; the lights, face and holiday props don't change.

settings.title: Appearance
settings.description: Robot, or Robot Cat: the same robot with cat ears, a floating tail and a cat's face.
